dct_title_s: Satellite detected water extents between 15 and 19 August 2024 over Chad
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: FL20240820TCD** This map illustrates cumulative satellite-detected water using VIIRS in Chad between 15 to 19 August 2024. Within the cloud free analysed areas of about 1,200,000 km², a total of about 19,000 km² of lands appear to be affected with flood waters. Based on Worldpop population data and the maximal flood water extent ~700,000 people are potentially exposed or living close to flooded areas. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
